name: Glute-Ham Raise
steps: Use a horizontal hyperextension bench designed for glute-ham raises, with a rounded thigh pad, ankle rollers and footplate.
Secure your ankles, brace your feet against the plate and position your knees just behind the rounded pad.
Start tall with your knees bent at 90 degrees, torso upright, arms crossed over your chest, and glutes and abs tightly braced.
Lower your torso forward and downward slowly by extending your knees while keeping a straight line from your knees through your shoulders.
At horizontal, contract your hamstrings and glutes forcefully to curl your body smoothly back up to the upright starting position.
tips: Keep your hips extended in line with your torso rather than bending sharply at the waist.
Keep your feet firmly against the plate as your body pivots around the knees.
